name: update_memory
description: Update an existing persistent memory fact in place: correct its content, refresh its summary, narrow its kind, or add tags. Identify the fact by its id (from recall_memory or the save_memory response). Use it to fix or enrich what memory holds instead of saving a conflicting duplicate.

id.description: Id of the memory fact to update, as returned by save_memory or recall_memory.

content.description: Optional new concise content for the fact (max 500 characters). Omit to keep the current one.

summary.description: Optional new short label (max 72 characters, like a commit subject). Omit to keep the current one.

kind.description: Optional new category guiding retention and sharing. Omit to keep the current one.

tags.description: Optional extra tags to add to the fact's existing tags.
